notes.required_skills: Share of job-required skills that are evidenced in the resume.
notes.preferred_skills: Share of preferred/nice-to-have skills that are evidenced in the resume.
notes.relevant_experience: Overlap between job experience themes and resume experience/project evidence.
notes.education: Overlap between stated qualifications and resume education/certifications.
notes.supporting_evidence: Whether matched skills are backed by project or work-history quotes.
